key_insight: GuideEvolve combines expert-guided agent evolution with three self-regulation mechanisms to improve reliability while maintaining competitive benchmark accuracy.
engineering_relevance: More consistent evolution and fewer optimization iterations could make self-evolving agents easier to operate in production.
method: Use task-specific expert evaluation to guide agent evolution.
Apply Think Fast and Slow for cognitive optimization and Throwback for temporal rollback.
Use Termination by choice to adaptively stop evolution.
evidence_signal: On MGSM/MMLU, GuideEvolve reports 89.8%/89.1% accuracy versus Gödel Agent’s 90.6%/87.9%, 25–59% lower variance, 100% versus 82% evolution success, and 15.1/13.4 versus 30 optimization iterations.
watch_item: Results cover two benchmarks; expert-evaluation costs and robustness in production settings remain unclear from the abstract.
paper_title: GuideEvolve: Self-Evolving Agent Framework with Expert Guidance and 3Ts Mechanisms
